name: Bangladesh Railway — station phones and district-wise station counts (Barishal Division)
notes: No railway in Barishal Division. The Information Book 2023-24 Table-4 ('District-wise station & route kilometers', 49 districts, 542 stations) has no row for Barishal, Bhola, Patuakhali, Pirojpur, Jhalokathi or Barguna, and the 'important stations' BTCL phone list names no station in the division; places.csv and facts.csv are header-only and both texts are kept in raw/ as evidence. No licence stated. railway.gov.bd publishes no station register; eticket.railway.gov.bd robots.txt disallows all crawling, so its station list was not used.
